Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add React frontend application with full-text search integration

Implement a production-ready React application that provides a user-friendly
interface for the Discussion Forum API with the following features:

Features:
- Topic browsing with MySQL full-text search integration
- Topic and post creation with real-time updates
- User selection with localStorage persistence
- Responsive design with Tailwind CSS
- Toast notifications for user feedback
- WCAG 2.1 Level A accessibility compliance

Technical Stack:
- React 18.3 + TypeScript \(strict mode\)
- Vite 5.0 for fast HMR and build
- React Query 5.17 for server state management
- React Router 6.22 for client-side routing
- Axios with error interceptors
- Tailwind CSS 3.4 for styling

Architecture:
- Pragmatic hybrid: React Query for server state, Context API for client
- Clean separation: API layer → Components → Pages
- TypeScript types mirror Go backend models
- Cache strategy matches backend Redis TTLs \(2-5 minutes\)

Quality Improvements:
- Fixed memory leak in ToastContext with proper timeout cleanup
- Fixed search race condition using current query value
- Added invalid topic ID validation \(NaN check\)
- Improved modal accessibility with ARIA attributes and Escape key handler
- Added performance optimizations with useMemo and useCallback
- CORS fix: Use Vite proxy instead of direct API calls

Project includes:
- 50+ TypeScript/TSX files \(~2,400 lines of code\)
- Comprehensive README with setup instructions
- Complete implementation summary documentation

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
